UI: \u2461 Court Contribution (IDR).name: UI: ② Court Contribution (IDR)
UI: \u2461 Court Contribution (IDR).description: Display wrapper for ② Court Contribution (IDR). Red bold. Repositioned to the ② court block alongside Court Rental (v11.1). Renamed UI: ② Court Costs → Court Contribution (10 Jul 2026, WS1-R4); originally UI: ⑦ Court Subsidy (IDR).

formula.expression: if(empty(prop("Scheduled")), empty(), style("② Court Contribution (IDR): " + if(empty(prop("Court Contribution (IDR)")), "0", format(round(prop("Court Contribution (IDR)"), 0))), "b", "red"))

Third Party %.name: Third Party %
Third Party %.description: Third party's share of Shared Net Sales for this product. Copied from Split Source Organisation at creation. Do not edit retroactively.

Wallet 2 Draw (IDR).name: Wallet 2 Draw (IDR)
Wallet 2 Draw (IDR).description: Exact monetary contribution from Wallet 2 to this lesson Sale. Blank when no second wallet is used.

Paid To.name: Paid To
Paid To.description: Who received the payment from the student. Club = club invoiced in the normal way. Tacit = Tacit collected directly (cash, transfer, or via a platform on Tacit's behalf). Determines whether a club invoice is required.

options.name: N/A (Cost Sale)
options.description: Confirmed Cost Sales only; no customer payment was collected.

Target Source System.name: Target Source System
Target Source System.description: Originating system for target-state provenance; source-neutral.

Shadow Calculation Revision.name: Shadow Calculation Revision
Shadow Calculation Revision.description: Version identifier for the shadow calculation.

Play with Coach (IDR PP).name: Play with Coach (IDR PP)
Play with Coach (IDR PP).description: Flat per-student price for the Play with Coach rotation product (beat-the-coach, 8–12 players, 2 courts). Club-set with Tacit approval; court included (Revenue Scope = Combined).

Financial Pricing Hours.name: Financial Pricing Hours
Financial Pricing Hours.description: Uses the scheduled parent Event duration only for an eligible Payment V1 paid-pending Clinic; all other routes retain the existing confirmed-only Total Hours value.

formula.expression:
lets(
  paidPendingClinic,
    prop("Financial Route") == "Payment V1" and
    prop("Sale Type") == "Clinic" and
    prop("Financial Release Ready"),
  if(
    paidPendingClinic,
    prop("Events")
      .filter(
        current.prop("Facility") == "On Court" and
        not empty(current.prop("Scheduled")) and
        empty(current.prop("Sub Event"))
      )
      .map(
        dateBetween(
          dateEnd(current.prop("Scheduled")),
          dateStart(current.prop("Scheduled")),
          "minutes"
        ) / 60
      )
      .sum(),
    toNumber(prop("Total Hours"))
  )
)

Discount Explanation.name: Discount Explanation
Discount Explanation.description: Free-text explanation of why a discount was applied to this sale. Complements the Discount Reason multi-select (which captures the category); this field captures the specific narrative/context behind the discount. Populated by Basil as a follow-up after Discount Reason is captured, and backfilled for historical discounted rows. Added via Change Request (Discount Explanation CR).

Wallet Value (IDR).name: Wallet Value (IDR)
Wallet Value (IDR).description: Cash paid upfront for the wallet. Set once at wallet creation. Parent wallet only; leave blank on lesson Sales. Wallet Opening Credit adds any Wallet Bonus Credit.

Shadow Validation State.name: Shadow Validation State
Shadow Validation State.description: Reconciliation state for shadow target-state fields.

Wallet Funding Check.name: Wallet Funding Check
Wallet Funding Check.description: Wallets 2.0 post-write validation. Detects incomplete or invalid slot data, duplicate or ineligible wallets, aggregate mismatch, overdraw and Wallet 2 use before Wallet 1 is exhausted. FIFO discovery remains Basil's responsibility.

formula.expression:
lets(
  wallet1Count, prop("Group").length(),
  wallet2Count, prop("Wallet 2").length(),
  wallet1Draw, if(empty(prop("Wallet 1 Draw (IDR)")), 0, prop("Wallet 1 Draw (IDR)")),
  wallet2Draw, if(empty(prop("Wallet 2 Draw (IDR)")), 0, prop("Wallet 2 Draw (IDR)")),
  aggregateDraw, if(empty(prop("Wallet Credit Draw (IDR)")), 0, prop("Wallet Credit Draw (IDR)")),
  walletIntent, prop("Discount Reason").includes("Wallet: Paid") or wallet2Count > 0 or wallet1Draw != 0 or wallet2Draw != 0,
  wallet1EligibleCount, prop("Group").filter(current.prop("Sale Role") == "Wallet" and current.prop("Sale Status") != "Cancelled" and not empty(current.prop("Wallet Value (IDR)")) and (current.prop("Wallet Type") == "EPA Late 26" or current.prop("Wallet Type") == "Proklamasi 26" or current.prop("Wallet Type") == "1945 26" or current.prop("Wallet Type") == "Garuda 26")).length(),
  wallet2EligibleCount, prop("Wallet 2").filter(current.prop("Sale Role") == "Wallet" and current.prop("Sale Status") != "Cancelled" and not empty(current.prop("Wallet Value (IDR)")) and (current.prop("Wallet Type") == "EPA Late 26" or current.prop("Wallet Type") == "Proklamasi 26" or current.prop("Wallet Type") == "1945 26" or current.prop("Wallet Type") == "Garuda 26")).length(),
  wallet1Id, prop("Group").map(id(current)).first(),
  wallet2Id, prop("Wallet 2").map(id(current)).first(),
  wallet1Remaining, prop("Group").map(current.prop("Wallet Credit Remaining (IDR)")).first(),
  wallet2Remaining, prop("Wallet 2").map(current.prop("Wallet Credit Remaining (IDR)")).first(),
  legacyAllocation, walletIntent and wallet1Count == 1 and wallet2Count == 0 and empty(prop("Wallet 1 Draw (IDR)")) and empty(prop("Wallet 2 Draw (IDR)")) and aggregateDraw > 0,
  ifs(
    not walletIntent, "",
    prop("Sale Status") == "Cancelled", "↩️ CANCELLED — credit reversed",
    legacyAllocation, "🟡 LEGACY — aggregate draw compatibility",
    prop("Sale Type") != "Private Lesson", "⛔ Only Private Lesson can use a wallet",
    not prop("Discount Reason").includes("Wallet: Paid"), "⛔ Missing Wallet: Paid reason",
    wallet1Count != 1, "⛔ Wallet 1 must contain exactly one wallet",
    wallet2Count > 1, "⛔ Wallet 2 must contain at most one wallet",
    wallet1EligibleCount != 1, "⛔ Wallet 1 is ineligible",
    wallet2Count == 1 and wallet2EligibleCount != 1, "⛔ Wallet 2 is ineligible",
    wallet2Count == 1 and wallet1Id == wallet2Id, "⛔ Wallet 1 and Wallet 2 are identical",
    wallet1Draw <= 0, "⛔ Wallet 1 draw must be positive",
    wallet2Count == 0 and wallet2Draw != 0, "⛔ Wallet 2 draw exists without Wallet 2",
    wallet2Count == 1 and wallet2Draw <= 0, "⛔ Wallet 2 requires a positive draw",
    aggregateDraw <= 0, "⛔ Aggregate wallet draw must be positive",
    round(wallet1Draw + wallet2Draw, 0) != round(aggregateDraw, 0), "⛔ Slot draws do not equal aggregate wallet draw",
    wallet1Remaining < 0, "⛔ Wallet 1 overdrawn",
    wallet2Count == 1 and wallet2Remaining < 0, "⛔ Wallet 2 overdrawn",
    wallet2Count == 1 and wallet1Remaining != 0, "⛔ Wallet 2 used before Wallet 1 exhausted",
    "✅ OK"
  )
)

Discount Reason.name: Discount Reason
Discount Reason.description: Why a discount was applied to this sale. Multi-select — a sale can carry more than one reason. Options are expected to evolve; add future options via a Change Request.

Coaches Course (IDR PP).name: Coaches Course (IDR PP)
Coaches Course (IDR PP).description: Price (IDR) per student for coaching academy programmes

Tacit Discount %.name: Tacit Discount %
Tacit Discount %.description: Discount absorbed 100% by Tacit. Club and coach are PROTECTED — their shares aren't reduced. Renamed from Discretionary Discount % (8 Feb 2026).

Database Group.name: Database Group
Database Group.description: Functional group classification from Source Databases page

Final Charged Price (IDR).name: Final Charged Price (IDR)
Final Charged Price (IDR).description: Immutable final amount charged after permitted adjustments. This is an audit snapshot, not a second calculation input.

Event Status.name: Event Status
Event Status.description: Event Status from related Event. Returns empty if no Event linked.

Sale Type.name: Sale Type
Sale Type.description: Product type for this sale. Set once at creation, never changed. 6 live values: Private Lesson, Match with Coach, Play with Coach, Player Academy, Coaches Academy, Clinic. (22 Jun 2026: the former 'Play with Coach' was renamed to 'Match with Coach'; a new 'Play with Coach' beat-the-coach rotation product was added.)

Revenue Scope.description: Revenue scope for this product. Copied from Split Source Organisation at creation. Academy fees only = court rental deducted before split. Everything = court + coaching pooled.

Wallet Credit Remaining (IDR).name: Wallet Credit Remaining (IDR)
Wallet Credit Remaining (IDR).description: Opening monetary credit minus used monetary credit. Active finite wallet parent only.

Shadow Expected Court Settlement (IDR).name: Shadow Expected Court Settlement (IDR)
Shadow Expected Court Settlement (IDR).description: Expected court settlement for the financial unit. Shadow only.

Target Financial Unit.name: Target Financial Unit
Target Financial Unit.description: The event or payable financial unit for target-state validation. Shadow only.

UI: \u2470 Community Funding (IDR).name: UI: ⑰ Community Funding (IDR)
UI: \u2470 Community Funding (IDR).description: Display wrapper for ⑰ Community Funding allocation.

if(empty(prop("Scheduled")), empty(), style("⑪ Club Net Sales (IDR): " + format(round(prop("Club Net Sales (IDR)"), 0)), "b", "red"))

Shadow Applied Coach Level 2.name: Shadow Applied Coach Level 2
Shadow Applied Coach Level 2.description: Coach level applied by the second shadow calculation.

OPEX (IDR).name: OPEX (IDR)
OPEX (IDR).description: 30% of Tacit Gross Profit allocated to operating expenses. Reduced from 40% on 2 May 2026 (Community Funding layer added).

Event Capacity.name: Event Capacity
Event Capacity.description: Planned capacity rolled down from the linked Event. Used as the Court Contribution denominator (Court Rental ÷ Event Capacity = per-seat court charge).

Tacit Net Sales (IDR).name: Tacit Net Sales (IDR)
Tacit Net Sales (IDR).description: Shared Net Sales minus Club Net Sales. Tacit absorbs all Tacit Discount impact here.

Classroom Hours.name: Classroom Hours
Classroom Hours.description: Total hours spent in classroom for this product

formula.expression: lets(mainClassroomHours, prop("Events").filter(current.prop("Facility") == "Classroom" and not empty(current.prop("Scheduled")) and current.prop("Status") == "Confirmed" and empty(current.prop("Sub Event"))).map(dateBetween(dateEnd(current.prop("Scheduled")), dateStart(current.prop("Scheduled")), "minutes") / 60), subClassroomHours, prop("Events").map(current.prop("Sub Event").filter(current.prop("Facility") == "Classroom" and not empty(current.prop("Scheduled")) and current.prop("Status") == "Confirmed").map(dateBetween(dateEnd(current.prop("Scheduled")), dateStart(current.prop("Scheduled")), "minutes") / 60)).flat(), sum(mainClassroomHours.concat(subClassroomHours)))
if(empty(prop("Scheduled")), empty(), if(empty(prop("Dividends (IDR)")), "⑱ Dividends (IDR): 0", "⑱ Dividends (IDR): " + format(round(prop("Dividends (IDR)"), 0))))

Total Hours.name: Total Hours
Total Hours.description: Sum of all session hours (On Court + Classroom + Gym)

formula.expression: prop("On Court Hours")+prop("Classroom Hours")+prop("Gym Hours")

Wallet Bonus Credit (IDR).name: Wallet Bonus Credit (IDR)
Wallet Bonus Credit (IDR).description: Promotional credit added to the cash Wallet Value. Parent wallet only; leave blank on child Sales.

Clinic Level.name: Clinic Level
Clinic Level.description: Descriptive tag only — no pricing role. Retained on historical Open/Weekly Clinic rows for reporting. Live clinic pricing is the field-driven, PL-anchored Clinic (IDR PP) (Basil-stamped at the realised ratio).

Total Income (IDR).name: Total Income (IDR)
Total Income (IDR).description: Full amount collected from students. Students × Price × Hours. Only when Event = Confirmed.

formula.expression:
ifs(
  not prop("Financial Release Ready"), 0,
  prop("Sale Role") == "Cost", 0,
  round(
    (empty(prop("Academy Fees (IDR)")) ? 0 : prop("Academy Fees (IDR)")) +
    (empty(prop("Court Contribution (IDR)")) ? 0 : prop("Court Contribution (IDR)")),
    0
  )
)

Coaches Fee (IDR).name: Coaches Fee (IDR)
Coaches Fee (IDR).description: Total coach compensation for this sale. Sum of Coaches Fee from linked Events (which itself sums HR Fee records).

Tacit Gross Profit (IDR).name: Tacit Gross Profit (IDR)
Tacit Gross Profit (IDR).description: Tacit Net Sales − Coaches Fee. Profit after paying coaches.

formula.expression: lets(bs, prop("Balance Sheet"), hasAccess, bs.length() > 0, if(!hasAccess, 0, if(empty(prop("Tacit Net Sales (IDR)")), 0, prop("Tacit Net Sales (IDR)")) - if(empty(prop("Coaches Fee Waterfall (IDR)")), 0, prop("Coaches Fee Waterfall (IDR)"))))

Financial Route.name: Financial Route
Financial Route.description: Controls which financial-processing route applies. Existing records remain blank; a later activation unit will define controlled defaults.

Tacit %.name: Tacit %
Tacit %.description: Tacit's share of Shared Net Sales for this product. Copied from Split Source Organisation at creation. Do not edit retroactively.

Gym Hours.name: Gym Hours
Gym Hours.description: Total hours spent in gym for this product

formula.expression: lets(mainGymHours, prop("Events").filter(current.prop("Facility") == "Gym" and not empty(current.prop("Scheduled")) and current.prop("Status") == "Confirmed" and empty(current.prop("Sub Event"))).map(dateBetween(dateEnd(current.prop("Scheduled")), dateStart(current.prop("Scheduled")), "minutes") / 60), subGymHours, prop("Events").map(current.prop("Sub Event").filter(current.prop("Facility") == "Gym" and not empty(current.prop("Scheduled")) and current.prop("Status") == "Confirmed").map(dateBetween(dateEnd(current.prop("Scheduled")), dateStart(current.prop("Scheduled")), "minutes") / 60)).flat(), round(sum(mainGymHours.concat(subGymHours)), 2))

Shadow Coach Fee Basis.name: Shadow Coach Fee Basis
Shadow Coach Fee Basis.description: Reason code for the shadow coach-fee result.

Court Rental (IDR).name: Court Rental (IDR)
Court Rental (IDR).description: Amount paid to club for court rental. Flat: On Court Hours × Court Hourly Rate (one court per session regardless of headcount). 0 when Revenue Scope = Combined. 0 when Sale Type = Coaches Academy (explicit guard — CA has no court cost). v11: multiplier removed. CA guard added 1 Jul 2026.

formula.expression:
lets(
  revenueScope, prop("Revenue Scope"),
  saleType, prop("Sale Type"),
  ifs(
    not prop("Financial Release Ready"), 0,
    saleType == "Coaches Academy", 0,
    revenueScope == "Combined", 0,
    empty(prop("Financial Pricing Hours")), 0,
    empty(prop("Court Hourly Rate (IDR)")), 0,
    round(prop("Financial Pricing Hours") * prop("Court Hourly Rate (IDR)"), 0)
  )
)

Wallet 1 Used (IDR).name: Wallet 1 Used (IDR)
Wallet 1 Used (IDR).description: Sum of explicit Wallet 1 Draw values from Item children. Internal Wallets 2.0 aggregation helper.

VAT (IDR).name: VAT (IDR)
VAT (IDR).description: Academy Fees × VAT %. 0% default when VAT % is empty. Hardcoded 0.11 fallback removed.

formula.expression: if(empty(prop("Academy Fees (IDR)")) or prop("Academy Fees (IDR)") <= 0, 0, round(prop("Academy Fees (IDR)") * if(empty(prop("VAT %")), 0, prop("VAT %")), 0))

Shadow Expected Coach Fee (IDR).name: Shadow Expected Coach Fee (IDR)
Shadow Expected Coach Fee (IDR).description: Expected coach compensation under the target calculation. Shadow only.

Paid Students.name: Paid Students
Paid Students.description: Count of student booking (Revenue) rows linked to this Cost row via the Item relation. Court Contribution numerator input: the 'Paid Students' term in max(Court Rental − (Court Rental ÷ Event Capacity) × Paid Students, 0). Applies on the Cost row only. Added 1 Jul 2026 (WS1, authorised under Nick's Section 7 sign-off). Counts all linked Item rows; any confirmed-only refinement is handled in Felix's Court Contribution formula.

Payment Verification Note.name: Payment Verification Note
Payment Verification Note.description: Concise evidence or director-confirmation note supporting payment verification.

formula.expression: if(empty(prop("Scheduled")), empty(), style("⑨ Shared Net Sales (IDR): " + format(round(prop("Shared Net Sales (IDR)"), 0)), "b", "green"))

Min. Access.description: Outputs the minimum access group detected across Can Edit/Can Comment/Can View.

Payment Verified By.description: The named person who verified payment.

Emits this Sale page's unhyphenated Notion UUID through id(); the Tacit Payment V1 Automation Worker normalises it and uses it to retrieve the exact Sale triggered by Payment Processing Status = Ready to process. Webhook Content must include this property only. Do not edit.

SKU.name: SKU
SKU.description: Unique product identifier. TP- prefix + zero-padded 6-digit auto-increment ID. Simplified post-Decision 5 (no parent/child Product/Sale).

Club Net Sales (IDR).name: Club Net Sales (IDR)
Club Net Sales (IDR).description: Club's PROTECTED share = round(protectedNetSales × Club %). v11.1 (9 Jul 2026): court no longer deducted — club bears none of the underfill and receives the full court rental separately.

Wallet 2.name: Wallet 2

Community Funding (IDR).name: Community Funding (IDR)

Price Per Student (IDR).name: Price Per Student (IDR)
Price Per Student (IDR).description: Calculated price per student based on coach level, group size, and session duration from linked Events

formula.expression:
lets(
  saleType, {{notion:block_property:F%3Fuv:00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000:728afdfb-c3c7-816d-b8e3-0003a3b6442c}},
  /* Get coach level from first coach in Coaches relation */
  coachLevel, {{notion:block_property:Xqp%7C:00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000:728afdfb-c3c7-816d-b8e3-0003a3b6442c}}.first().{{notion:block_property:Lx%40J:261afdfb-c3c7-81f8-8cda-000ba9e72403:728afdfb-c3c7-816d-b8e3-0003a3b6442c}},
  /* Count students from Students relation */
  studentCount, {{notion:block_property:m%3BGB:00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000:728afdfb-c3c7-816d-b8e3-0003a3b6442c}}.length(),
  /* Determine student ratio based on count */
  studentRatio, ifs(
    studentCount == 1, "1:1",
    studentCount == 2, "1:2",
    studentCount == 3, "1:3",
    studentCount >= 4, "1:4",
    "1:1"
  ),
  tier, {{notion:block_property:wvzf:00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000:728afdfb-c3c7-816d-b8e3-0003a3b6442c}},
  /* Clinic ratio from planned Event Capacity; blank when capacity missing so the clinic row blocks (price 0) per the block-the-row rule */
  clinicRatio, if(
    empty({{notion:block_property:JMFu:00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000:728afdfb-c3c7-816d-b8e3-0003a3b6442c}}),
    "",
    "1:" + format({{notion:block_property:JMFu:00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000:728afdfb-c3c7-816d-b8e3-0003a3b6442c}}.first())
  ),
  /* Return price per student based on all conditions */
  ifs(
    {{notion:block_property:U%3DGM:00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000:728afdfb-c3c7-816d-b8e3-0003a3b6442c}}.map(current.format()).first() == "Overseas Clubs" and
    {{notion:block_property:hsZx:00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000:728afdfb-c3c7-816d-b8e3-0003a3b6442c}}.map(current.format()).first() == "Serve Padel Club",
    {{notion:block_property:bc~E:00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000:728afdfb-c3c7-816d-b8e3-0003a3b6442c}},

    saleType == "Clinic" and {{notion:block_property:G%3BR%7C:00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000:728afdfb-c3c7-816d-b8e3-0003a3b6442c}} == "Combined",
    {{notion:block_property:jG%3C%3D:00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000:728afdfb-c3c7-816d-b8e3-0003a3b6442c}},

    saleType == "Private Lesson" and coachLevel == "Head Coach" and studentRatio == "1:1",
    {{notion:block_property:kFIv:00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000:728afdfb-c3c7-816d-b8e3-0003a3b6442c}},
    saleType == "Private Lesson" and coachLevel == "Head Coach" and studentRatio == "1:2",
    {{notion:block_property:~DFB:00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000:728afdfb-c3c7-816d-b8e3-0003a3b6442c}},
    saleType == "Private Lesson" and coachLevel == "Head Coach" and studentRatio == "1:3",
    {{notion:block_property:wjlb:00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000:728afdfb-c3c7-816d-b8e3-0003a3b6442c}},
    saleType == "Private Lesson" and coachLevel == "Head Coach" and studentRatio == "1:4",
    {{notion:block_property:PQ%3FG:00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000:728afdfb-c3c7-816d-b8e3-0003a3b6442c}},

    saleType == "Private Lesson" and coachLevel == "Senior Coach" and studentRatio == "1:1",
    {{notion:block_property:TEjO:00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000:728afdfb-c3c7-816d-b8e3-0003a3b6442c}},
    saleType == "Private Lesson" and coachLevel == "Senior Coach" and studentRatio == "1:2",
    {{notion:block_property:K~%3D%3B:00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000:728afdfb-c3c7-816d-b8e3-0003a3b6442c}},
    saleType == "Private Lesson" and coachLevel == "Senior Coach" and studentRatio == "1:3",
    {{notion:block_property:%5DQHi:00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000:728afdfb-c3c7-816d-b8e3-0003a3b6442c}},
    saleType == "Private Lesson" and coachLevel == "Senior Coach" and studentRatio == "1:4",
    {{notion:block_property:pgMz:00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000:728afdfb-c3c7-816d-b8e3-0003a3b6442c}},

    saleType == "Private Lesson" and coachLevel == "Coach" and studentRatio == "1:1",
    {{notion:block_property:nksW:00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000:728afdfb-c3c7-816d-b8e3-0003a3b6442c}},
    saleType == "Private Lesson" and coachLevel == "Coach" and studentRatio == "1:2",
    {{notion:block_property:%7CY%7DA:00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000:728afdfb-c3c7-816d-b8e3-0003a3b6442c}},
    saleType == "Private Lesson" and coachLevel == "Coach" and studentRatio == "1:3",

    saleType == "Private Lesson" and coachLevel == "Coach" and studentRatio == "1:4",
    {{notion:block_property:saDm:00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000:728afdfb-c3c7-816d-b8e3-0003a3b6442c}},

    saleType == "Private Lesson" and coachLevel == "Instructor" and studentRatio == "1:1",
    {{notion:block_property:pfMR:00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000:728afdfb-c3c7-816d-b8e3-0003a3b6442c}},
    saleType == "Private Lesson" and coachLevel == "Instructor" and studentRatio == "1:2",

    saleType == "Private Lesson" and coachLevel == "Instructor" and studentRatio == "1:4",
    {{notion:block_property:oW%40L:00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000:728afdfb-c3c7-816d-b8e3-0003a3b6442c}},

Wallet 1 Draw (IDR).name: Wallet 1 Draw (IDR)
Wallet 1 Draw (IDR).description: Exact monetary contribution from Group / Wallet 1 to this lesson Sale. Stored by Basil after final balance recheck.

Platform Commission %.name: Platform Commission %
Platform Commission %.description: Percentage deducted for booking platform commission (e.g., Courtside, Playtomic)

Wallet 2 Item.name: Wallet 2 Item
Wallet 2 Item.description: Inverse list of lesson Sales funded from this wallet through the Wallet 2 slot.

Court Contribution (IDR).name: Court Contribution (IDR)
Court Contribution (IDR).description: Court contribution, context-aware by Sale Role (② model, v11.1). Cost row = the court underfill borne 100% by Tacit: max(Court Rental − (Court Rental ÷ Event Capacity) × Paid Students, 0), booked once to the Balance Sheet via Sales: BS (via Cost). Revenue row = this seat's court charge to the club: Court Rental ÷ Event Capacity. Outside the coaching waterfall — does not reduce Academy Fees, VAT, or the split; the club always receives the full court rental. Guard OFF (Nick, 9 Jul): exact division, no per-seat rounding. Renamed Court Costs → Court Contribution (10 Jul 2026, WS1-R4 — value-invariant cosmetic rename; both rows read as contributions to the shared court pool: player contributes, Tacit tops up shortfalls, club keeps surplus). Originally Court Subsidy.

Target Financial Purpose.name: Target Financial Purpose
Target Financial Purpose.description: Target-state financial role. Shadow only; does not alter current ledger routes.

Revenue Date.name: Revenue Date
Revenue Date.description: The date revenue is attributed to. For private lessons, this is the session date. For academies, this is the programme start date. Used as the X-axis for chart views (native date required — formulas and rollups cannot be used for chart date grouping).

Target Source Revision.name: Target Source Revision
Target Source Revision.description: Source revision marker used for target-state validation.

Effective Coaching Rate (IDR).name: Effective Coaching Rate (IDR)
Effective Coaching Rate (IDR).description: Payment V1 uses its immutable resolved coaching-rate snapshot; Legacy continues to use Price Per Student unchanged.

formula.expression:
lets(
  t, if(empty(prop("Tacit %")), 0, round(prop("Tacit %") * 100)),
  c, if(empty(prop("Club %")), 0, round(prop("Club %") * 100)),
  tp, if(empty(prop("Third Party %")), 0, round(prop("Third Party %") * 100)),
  "Tacit " + format(t) + "% · Club " + format(c) + "% · Third Party " + format(tp) + "%"
)

Price List.name: Price List
Price List.description: Price period used to resolve this Sale. Preserved as transaction history.

Shared Net Sales (IDR).name: Shared Net Sales (IDR)
Shared Net Sales (IDR).description: Academy Fees − VAT − Platform Commission − Transaction Fees. Pre-split amount. v11.1 (9 Jul 2026): court deduction removed — court is out of the coaching waterfall.

Sale Role.name: Sale Role
Sale Role.description: Wallet = prepaid credit parent (holds Wallet Value; child bookings link to it via the Group relation). Cost = fee-only record created at event creation (no student). Revenue = student booking row (no fee). Blank = safe default (treated as full fee).

Shadow Coach Fee Basis 2.name: Shadow Coach Fee Basis 2
Shadow Coach Fee Basis 2.description: Reason code for the second coach-fee result.

Financial Release Ready.name: Financial Release Ready
Financial Release Ready.description: Controlled payment-release gate. Legacy rows release only when confirmed; Payment V1 paid-pending release is limited to eligible Revenue and linked Cost rows.

formula.expression:
lets(
  paymentVerified,
    not empty(prop("Payment Verified At")) and
    not empty(prop("Payment Verified By")),
  financiallyChargeable,
    prop("Sale Status") != "Cancelled",
  supportedPaidPendingType,
    prop("Sale Type") == "Clinic" or
    prop("Sale Type") == "Coaches Academy" or
    prop("Sale Type") == "Play with Coach",
  eligibleV1PaidPlace,
    prop("Financial Route") == "Payment V1" and
    prop("Sale Role") == "Revenue" and
    prop("Event Status") == "Pending" and
    supportedPaidPendingType and
    financiallyChargeable and
    paymentVerified,
  eligibleV1SharedCost,
    prop("Financial Route") == "Payment V1" and
    prop("Sale Role") == "Cost" and
    prop("Event Status") == "Pending" and
    supportedPaidPendingType and
    prop("Item").filter(
      current.prop("Sale Role") == "Revenue" and
      current.prop("Sale Status") != "Cancelled" and
      not empty(current.prop("Payment Verified At")) and
      not empty(current.prop("Payment Verified By"))
    ).length() > 0,
  financiallyChargeable and (
    prop("Event Status") == "Confirmed" or
    eligibleV1PaidPlace or
    eligibleV1SharedCost
  )
)

VAT %.name: VAT %
VAT %.description: VAT rate. Default 0% (Pricing template). Tacit Padel is below the IDR 4.8B threshold — no VAT charged. Configurable per product if/when threshold is crossed. Updated 20 Apr 2026 — was incorrectly described as '11% in Indonesia'.

Academy Fees (IDR).name: Academy Fees (IDR)
Academy Fees (IDR).description: Actual coaching revenue after all discounts. VAT and Net Sales calculated from this. Consolidates discount logic (2 Feb 2026).

Target Source Key.name: Target Source Key
Target Source Key.description: Stable source record key for target-state provenance.

Coaches Fee Waterfall (IDR).name: Coaches Fee Waterfall (IDR)
Coaches Fee Waterfall (IDR).description: Gate formula. Returns 0 for Revenue rows (student bookings carry no coach cost). Returns Coaches Fee (IDR) rollup for Cost, Wallet, and blank rows. Blank defaults to full fee — safe for all existing unstamped records.

Wallet Credit Used (IDR).name: Wallet Credit Used (IDR)
Wallet Credit Used (IDR).description: Wallets 2.0 total used credit. Sums Wallet 1 slot draws through Item, legacy aggregate draws when both slot fields are blank, and Wallet 2 slot draws through Wallet 2 Item. Cancelled children are excluded.

formula.expression:
lets(
  activeFiniteWallet, prop("Wallet Type") == "EPA Late 26" or prop("Wallet Type") == "Proklamasi 26" or prop("Wallet Type") == "1945 26" or prop("Wallet Type") == "Garuda 26",
  isWalletParent, activeFiniteWallet and prop("Sale Role") == "Wallet" and not empty(prop("Wallet Value (IDR)")),
  wallet1Explicit, if(empty(prop("Wallet 1 Used (IDR)")), 0, toNumber(prop("Wallet 1 Used (IDR)"))),
  wallet2Explicit, if(empty(prop("Wallet 2 Used (IDR)")), 0, toNumber(prop("Wallet 2 Used (IDR)"))),
  legacyUsed, prop("Item")
    .filter(current.prop("Sale Status") != "Cancelled" and empty(current.prop("Wallet 1 Draw (IDR)")) and empty(current.prop("Wallet 2 Draw (IDR)")))
    .map(current.prop("Wallet Credit Draw (IDR)"))
    .sum(),
  if(not isWalletParent, empty(), round(wallet1Explicit + wallet2Explicit + legacyUsed, 0))
)

lets(bs, prop("Balance Sheet"), hasAccess, bs.length() > 0, if(empty(prop("Scheduled")), empty(), style("⑭ Coaches Fee (IDR): " + format(round(if(!hasAccess, 0, prop("Coaches Fee Waterfall (IDR)")), 0)), "b", "red")))

Target Source Key 2.name: Target Source Key 2
Target Source Key 2.description: Stable source identity for the second coach-compensation record. Shadow only.

Tacit Discount (IDR).name: Tacit Discount (IDR)
Tacit Discount (IDR).description: IDR amount of the Tacit Discount (applied after Shared Discount). Tacit absorbs 100% of this discount.

Sale Status.name: Sale Status
Sale Status.description: Lifecycle status of this sale. Confirmed = paid and committed. Cancelled = cancelled (check Cancelled By). Late Cancellation = cancelled inside notice window. No-Show = customer did not attend.

UI: \u246b Third Party Net Sales (IDR).name: UI: ⑫ Third Party Net Sales (IDR)
UI: \u246b Third Party Net Sales (IDR).description: Display formula for ⑫ Third Party Net Sales. Red bold, only shows when Scheduled exists.

formula.expression: if(empty(prop("Scheduled")) or empty(prop("Third Party Net Sales (IDR)")), empty(), style("⑫ Third Party Net Sales (IDR): " + format(round(prop("Third Party Net Sales (IDR)"), 0)), "b", "red"))

Cancelled By.name: Cancelled By
Cancelled By.description: Who initiated the cancellation. Student = customer cancelled. Tacit = Tacit cancelled (e.g. coach sick, below minimum). Club = the club/venue cancelled the session. Only set when Sale Status is Cancelled, Late Cancellation, or No-Show. Aligned with TP: Events "Cancelled By..." options 16 Jul 2026.

Clinic (IDR PP).name: Clinic (IDR PP)
Clinic (IDR PP).description: Actual per-student price charged for a Clinic (coaching + court combined), e.g. Nord 450 / Elite 425. v11.1 (WS1-R3, 10 Jul 2026): REPURPOSED as the actual per-seat list price — it is NO LONGER the coaching rate. The coaching rate now comes from the delivering coach's own PL rate columns (Coach Level × realised ratio from Event Capacity) via Price Per Student → Tacit List Price. This field feeds Court Contribution only: Revenue-row seat court charge = (Clinic (IDR PP) − Price Per Student) × Total Hours. Court is billed separately to the club. (Supersedes the v11 'Basil stamps the PL rate at the realised ratio' usage.)

Wallet 2 Used (IDR).name: Wallet 2 Used (IDR)
Wallet 2 Used (IDR).description: Sum of explicit Wallet 2 Draw values from Wallet 2 Item children. Internal Wallets 2.0 aggregation helper.

Club %.name: Club %
Club %.description: Club's share of Shared Net Sales for this product. Copied from Split Source Organisation at creation. Do not edit retroactively.

Payment Channel.name: Payment Channel
Payment Channel.description: Collection route/funding classification. Club = club-collected; Wallet = wallet-funded lesson; Courtside and Bank transfer = Tacit receipt routes; Cost = marker only for records with Sale Role = Cost. Leave unknown or unverified records blank.

options.name: Ayo
options.description: Club-collected payment through Ayo. Use Paid To = Club.

options.name: Reclub
options.description: Club-collected payment through Reclub. Use Paid To = Club.

Transaction Fee %.name: Transaction Fee %
Transaction Fee %.description: Percentage deducted for payment gateway or transaction processing fees

On Court Hours.name: On Court Hours
On Court Hours.description: Total hours spent on court for this product

formula.expression: lets(calculateHours, prop("Events").filter(current.prop("Facility") == "On Court" and not empty(current.prop("Scheduled")) and current.prop("Status") == "Confirmed" and empty(current.prop("Sub Event"))).map(dateBetween(dateEnd(current.prop("Scheduled")), dateStart(current.prop("Scheduled")), "minutes") / 60), subEventHours, prop("Events").map(current.prop("Sub Event").filter(current.prop("Facility") == "On Court" and not empty(current.prop("Scheduled")) and current.prop("Status") == "Confirmed").map(dateBetween(dateEnd(current.prop("Scheduled")), dateStart(current.prop("Scheduled")), "minutes") / 60)).flat(), sum(calculateHours.concat(subEventHours)))

Shadow Applied Coach Level.description: Coach level applied by the shadow calculation.

Can Edit.description: Team members who have access to view/edit this product

Shared Discount (IDR).description: Shared by Tacit and the club only. Coaches are protected from Shared Discount.

Payment Processing Status.name: Payment Processing Status
Payment Processing Status.description: Manual V1 payment-processing control. Draft = payment facts being entered; Ready to process = authorised webhook trigger; Processing = Worker has claimed the Sale; Processed = Worker completed and verified the permitted Sales write; Exception = fail-closed manual review. This property is not a payment, delivery or financial-release status.
